title: r9lab-vocabulary
description: A SKOS vocabulary of product types and of component and material classes for repair and disassembly records, with typed crosswalks to CPC 2.1, UNU-KEYs, WEEE categories, PMDco, Wikidata and BAFU activity names, and an SSSOM mapping of the R9lab lab tags with a separate review log. The vocabulary and mappings are CC0 1.0; the code that builds and checks them is Apache-2.0 (see REUSE.toml).
